sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def snap(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    d={}
    beam=[(n['boundary'][0][0],n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in('w','g') and n['pixels']<=4 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50 and n['boundary'][0][1]>16]
    d['beam']=(min(c for r,c in beam),max(c for r,c in beam)) if beam else None
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in('R','b','N') and n['pixels']>=12 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            d[n['color']]=n['boundary'][0]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='M' and n['pixels']==18 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            d['P']=n['boundary'][0]
    return d
print("before:", snap(current_frame))
res = action(['LEFT'])
print("after 1 LEFT:", snap(current_frame))
print("res:", last_action_result.get('board_changed'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
